profit.label: FY2025 Net Loss for the Year

financialHighlights.informationNote: Figures are presented in billions of Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) and are taken directly from the audited Consolidated Financial Statements for the fiscal year ended 2025. The Company reported a net loss for the year, primarily due to opening balance adjustments (prior period reclassification) in accordance with PSAK 25, as disclosed in the financial statements. The reported net loss is presented without modification to maintain compliance with the Company's commitment to transparency and public disclosure.
